summary: A one-component demo page on djr.com for a striped variable colour font (COLR/CPAL): the font's own description, set editable at ~225px, fills the screen, and a small floating palette panel recolours the outline, fill and every stripe of the gradient live, with a slant slider and a randomise button. Below are only a short note on the Font of the Month Club release and DJR's standard site footer.

instances.look: DJR's 33px white site header above the demo (never cut as a block, attached to 00): 'DAVID JONATHAN ROSS' left, 'FONTS ▾ CLUB TYPESET GLYPHS NOTES ABOUT Sign in Cart' right in small spaced mono caps; collapses to 'MENU' on mobile

instances.variantDefinition: One editable sample in a colour font with a floating panel of colour pickers, one per palette layer (outline, fill, gradient stops, often auto-interpolated, plus a randomise button), that rewrites the font's colour palette live; any axis slider is secondary
instances.look: The first screen is the tester: eight lines of 'Megabase Stripe is a variable color font that divides each glyph into a series of diagonal stripes…' in tall, narrow, black-outlined capsule letters filled with lime-to-cyan diagonal stripes, running off the right edge; a narrow floating panel at the right edge holds swatches labelled Outline, Fill and Gradient (ten stops), a vertical SLANT slider, an 'Auto gradient' checkbox, a ↺ button, and a separate background swatch below
instances.ux: Click into the text to type; pick any swatch to recolour that layer across the whole text; with Auto gradient on only the two end stops are editable and the eight between interpolate; ↺ randomises all colours; the slider slants the letters (slnt -15 to 15); the panel stays fixed while you scroll
instances.learn: Give each colour layer of a COLR font its own swatch and interpolate the stops between two ends: visitors understand a 'fake gradient made of flat stripes' by making one

reconstruction.layout: Full-width editable block from y=33 to ~1820 (lines ~234px apart), text starts at x≈20 and overflows the right edge inside a horizontal scroll wrapper; fixed panel ~70×370px at right ≈50px from the edge, vertically centred, white with a 1px grey border and rounded corners; background swatch ~30×20px under it
reconstruction.typography: Sample ~225px Megabase Stripe (COLR/CPAL, served as a regenerated 'ColorFontCustomizr' font), leading ~1.04, default slnt 0; panel labels ~9px sans, 'SLANT' rotated 90°, swatch rows ~18px
reconstruction.behaviour: Spectrum colour pickers (input[type=color] replaced by .sp-replacer) per palette index; on change the page rebuilds the font's CPAL palette client-side and swaps the font-family to the new blob (ColorFontCustomizr1, 2…); Auto gradient interpolates indices 3–10 linearly between the first and last gradient colours and disables their pickers; ↺ picks random colours; range #axis-slnt (-15…15) writes font-variation-settings 'slnt'; the background picker sets the page colour
reconstruction.content: The font's own description as sample text (what COLR stripes are and why)
reconstruction.assets: Megabase Gradient colour font (COLR/CPAL); Spectrum colour-picker plugin
reconstruction.html: main#content > .scroll-wrapper > .big-text.preview[contenteditable][style=font-variation-settings, font-family]; #ui > ul.floatbox.color-choices > li.not-a-color (label + input#axis-slnt[type=range min=-15 max=15] + input#auto-gradient[type=checkbox]) + li.color[aria-label=Outline|Fill|Gradient] > input[type=color] + .sp-replacer ×12 + li.button > button.randomize-colors; .background-color-container > input.background-color

instances.look: Under the demo, a pale grey rounded box with one small paragraph: an experimental version of 'my Megabase', bands of colour to simulate gradients in COLR/CPAL '(for now)', released with OpenType-SVG and monochrome versions as the October 2020 Font of the Month Club, demo made with Chris Lewis
instances.ux: Links to the Megabase page, the OpenFontFormat GitHub issue, the Font of the Month notes post and Chris Lewis
instances.learn: Put the context (why stripes, which formats, which release) below the demo in one boxed paragraph so the toy comes first

reconstruction.layout: Box ~980px wide centred, ~130px tall, padding ~16px, 1px grey border, radius ~4px; ~60px below the sample
reconstruction.typography: ~15px Output Sans, leading ~1.5, bold for 'Megabase', the club edition and 'Chris Lewis'

instances.look: DJR's standard white footer in small mono: three columns (David Jonathan Ross RSS feeds and mailing list + Elsewhere links; Font of the Month Club + Typefaces list from Bungee to Warbler; Typeset, Glyph Navigator, Notes, About, Contact, Licensing, Press, Privacy, Tools incl. 'Color Font Customizer'); the demo's floating palette panel is stamped over its right edge
instances.ux: Links to every DJR family, licences and tools
instances.learn: A footer listing every family plus the tools used to build the demo turns a one-off experiment into an entry point to the catalogue

reconstruction.layout: 515px band; three columns at x≈250, 640 and 1040, headings then 16px rows
reconstruction.typography: ~11px Input Sans Narrow, headings bold tracked caps, links grey #555
